2. The applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No. 95/2026, registered with
Police Station Pusad City, Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, for the offences punishable under Sections 123,
223, 274 & 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 26(1), 26(2) (iv),
27(3)(e),30(2)(a) & 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable on 15.4.2026.
4.
Learned APP waives notice on behalf of non-applicant.
5. The contention is that the applicant is alleged to be the owner of the go-down from where prohibited scented Gutka has been seized.
It is further submitted that the entire material is already seized.
Since, the entire property has been seized by the investigating authority, custody of the applicant may not be 2 39aba242.2026..odt required.
6. Considering the submissions, the applicant can be granted ad interim protection.

Hence, the following order is passed:
i) Pending the application, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.
95/2026, registered with Police Station Pusad City, Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274 & 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 along with Sections 26(1), 26(2) (iv), 27(3)(e),30(2)(a) & 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, applicant Hameed Yakub Isani be released on bail on furnishing a P.R. bond of Rs.
